book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第二册
unit_cn: Unit 4 Breaking Boundaries 突破界限
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第二册 Unit 4 词表(p105-109 真词);IPA 英音照课本;例句原创、围绕'突破界限/无国界医生/全球村/林肯演说'主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: True friendship knows no boundary between people of different cultures.
words.example_cn: 真正的友谊不分文化、没有界限。

words.example_en: Every statistic in the report points to a rising number of volunteers.
words.example_cn: 报告中的每一项统计数据都显示志愿者人数在上升。

words.example_en: Local volunteers assist the doctors in the busy clinic every day.
words.example_cn: 当地志愿者每天在繁忙的诊所协助医生。

words.example_en: Doctors from many countries came together to tackle the disease.
words.example_cn: 来自许多国家的医生齐心协力对付这种疾病。

words.meaning_cn: 极其重要的,至关重要的
words.example_en: It is vital not to take any chances when fighting an outbreak.
words.example_cn: 对抗疫情爆发时,绝不冒险是至关重要的。

words.meaning_cn: 同志;(共患难的)朋友,伙伴
words.example_en: The health workers raised their glasses to their comrades from many nations.
words.example_cn: 卫生工作者们向来自许多国家的同志举杯致意。

words.example_en: He saw tragic scenes on the news and decided to offer his help.
words.example_cn: 他在新闻里看到悲惨的场面,决定去提供帮助。

words.example_en: There are no borders for those who combat this terrible disease.
words.example_cn: 对于抗击这种可怕疾病的人来说,没有边界。

words.meaning_cn: 接替,给(某人)换班;缓解,减轻
words.example_en: Her mission was to relieve a doctor at the end of her posting.
words.example_cn: 她的任务是接替一位即将结束派驻的医生。

words.example_en: Emma is a Canadian specialist in infectious diseases.
words.example_cn: 艾玛是一位加拿大的传染病专家。

words.example_en: The clinic mainly treats patients with infectious diseases.
words.example_cn: 这家诊所主要治疗患有传染病的病人。

words.example_en: Wilton helped carry the very sick into the treatment clinic.
words.example_cn: 威尔顿帮忙把重病患者抬进治疗诊所。

words.example_en: He worked hard to disinfect clothing and surfaces every day.
words.example_cn: 他每天努力给衣物和各种表面消毒。

words.example_en: Alfonso had worked on disease outbreaks in several countries.
words.example_cn: 阿方索曾在好几个国家参与应对疾病爆发。

words.example_en: Their devotion to the cause shone from their eyes.
words.example_cn: 他们对这项事业的奉献从眼神中闪现出来。

words.example_en: Our efforts do sometimes end in miracles, even against all odds.
words.example_cn: 尽管困难重重,我们的努力有时确实会以奇迹收场。

words.example_en: The twin girls and their parents were all infected.
words.example_cn: 那对双胞胎女孩和她们的父母都感染了。

words.example_en: When we visited the ward the next morning, both boys were still alive.
words.example_cn: 第二天早上我们去病房时,两个男孩都还活着。

words.example_en: This small success compensated for many less fortunate cases.
words.example_cn: 这一小小的成功弥补了许多不那么幸运的病例。

words.example_en: It is essential for us all to collaborate to build a better world.
words.example_cn: 我们所有人通力合作来建设一个更美好的世界,这是必不可少的。

words.example_en: We work to build a community with a shared future for mankind.
words.example_cn: 我们致力于构建人类命运共同体。

words.meaning_cn: (目标、希望)能够实现的;现实的
words.example_en: For minority actors, leading roles are now a more realistic hope.
words.example_cn: 对少数族裔演员来说,担任主角如今是更现实的希望了。

words.example_en: The report studied the roles given to women and minority actors.
words.example_cn: 这份报告研究了分配给女性和少数族裔演员的角色。

words.example_en: Some studios still cast white actors as Asian characters.
words.example_cn: 一些制片公司仍让白人演员出演亚洲角色。

words.meaning_cn: 包容广阔的;包括在内的
words.example_en: Cultural exchange helps us become more inclusive.
words.example_cn: 文化交流帮助我们变得更加包容。

words.example_en: Different countries make a joint effort to create a better world.
words.example_cn: 不同国家共同努力来创造一个更美好的世界。

words.example_en: Together we can build a more harmonious and understanding world.
words.example_cn: 我们携手就能建设一个更和谐、更包容理解的世界。

words.example_en: When cultures meet, both sides can enjoy the mutual benefits.
words.example_cn: 当不同文化相遇时,双方都能享受共同的益处。

words.example_en: It was rewarding to see how our work helped people from different cultures.
words.example_cn: 看到我们的工作帮助了来自不同文化的人们,很有意义。

words.example_en: A tall, thin man mounted the platform and began to speak.
words.example_cn: 一位瘦高的男子走上讲台开始讲话。

words.example_en: For two years, the country had been deep in a civil war.
words.example_cn: 两年来,这个国家深陷一场内战之中。

words.example_en: Lincoln understood the feelings of the civilian people.
words.example_cn: 林肯理解平民百姓的感受。

words.example_en: It was time to remove the divisions between North and South.
words.example_cn: 是时候消除南北之间的分裂了。

words.example_en: The new nation was conceived in liberty and dedicated to equality.
words.example_cn: 这个新国家孕育于自由,致力于平等。

words.example_en: The founders brought forth a nation dedicated to liberty.
words.example_cn: 缔造者们创建了一个献身于自由的国家。

words.meaning_cn: 致力于,献身于;把……奉献给
words.example_en: We come here to dedicate this ground to those who died for freedom.
words.example_cn: 我们来到这里,把这片土地献给那些为自由而牺牲的人。

words.example_en: He asked whether such a nation could long endure.
words.example_cn: 他发问:这样一个国家能否长久存续。

words.example_en: They met on a great battlefield of that war.
words.example_cn: 他们相聚在那场战争的一处大战场上。

words.example_en: They came to dedicate a portion of the field as a resting place.
words.example_cn: 他们前来把这片土地的一部分辟为安息之所。

words.example_en: It is altogether fitting that we should honour those who died here.
words.example_cn: 我们缅怀在此牺牲的人,这是完全恰当的。

words.example_en: Our poor words can add little or detract from their brave deeds.
words.example_cn: 我们苍白的言辞既无法增添、也无法贬损他们英勇的事迹。

words.example_en: The living must finish the work they so nobly carried on.
words.example_cn: 活着的人必须完成他们如此崇高地推进的事业。

words.example_en: He hoped this government of the people would never perish from the earth.
words.example_cn: 他希望这个民有的政府永不会从地球上消亡。

words.example_en: Edgar Snow wrote influential books about China in the 1930s.
words.example_cn: 埃德加·斯诺在20世纪30年代写了一些有影响力的关于中国的书。

words.example_en: His book told the stories of the Chinese communist movement from the inside.
words.example_cn: 他的书从内部讲述了中国共产主义运动的故事。

words.example_en: Lincoln helped break the boundaries that kept the slaves in chains.
words.example_cn: 林肯帮助打破了把奴隶束缚在枷锁中的界限。

words.example_en: Cultural exchange helps newcomers overcome culture shock more quickly.
words.example_cn: 文化交流帮助新来者更快地克服文化冲击。

words.example_en: He promised that the dead should not have died in vain.
words.example_cn: 他承诺,逝者绝不会白白牺牲。
